This far-reaching volume organizes logical data base design as a set of rules and techniques within the bounds of a single methological framework. This book provides all the information needed to develop a realistic working knowledge of effective logical data base design. The approaches have been proven in practice. They have been applied to small manual files and personal computer files as well as to extremely large data bases.
